name: Flotek Industries (NYSE) — oilfield chemistry / data analytics / power (PWRtek)
verdict: FLAT — NAMED KILL: DATA-INTEGRITY (the load-bearing upside number is unverifiable). The residual ex-PREPA backlog — the entire 'remaining business' thesis — exists in NO primary document: the brief's ~$100M is unsourced, the only competing figure (~$300M residual, from 57%-of-backlog) is an admitted short seller's estimate, and BOTH benches independently failed to source it. Buying this is buying a number that currently exists only in a short report and an unsourced note. Secondary unpriced tail: the Oversight Board referred the contract to law enforcement — no timetable, can surface any day, and FTK marketed the deal chain even though it is not the named contract party. NOTE WHAT THE KILL IS NOT: red's RP_TAINTED case (8/10) did NOT survive blue's audit — the adverse facts were public before FTK said anything (ERock's repudiation 8/7 public, Oversight Board revocation 8/14 by press release) and FTK's 8-K landed one business day after PREPA's own 8/17 stop-work directive; that is response latency, not concealment. Red's related-party kill INVERTED on trajectory: ProFrac 74.1% of Q1 -> 56.5% of Q2, external revenue +139% QoQ (though ex-ProFrac external growth is only +23.8% y/y — below red's own >=30% bar). And the prize table cuts LONG: the tape removed $385M for a project whose fully-funded NPV is <=$32M (~12x overreaction) — PREPA was never the thesis, so it cannot be the thesis-killer. What remains against: 19.2x guided FY26 EBITDA on a $895M cap (not $1.04B — pack share count wrong) with $11.0M total liquidity.
conviction: red 8/10 REJECT (two 'fatal' kills overturned) -> blue 7/10 FLAT; adjudicated FLAT on blue's surviving gate
